defects: BENT_KNEE_FOOT_NOT_AGAINST_WALL: Description says bend one knee and plant that foot flat against the wall behind you. Currently leftKnee=+70 produces foot FORWARD (leftAnkle z=+0.364, leftFoot z=+0.476 — in air forward) instead of BEHIND (against wall behind). Renderer convention: + knee = shin backward (correct for SEATED context where thigh is forward) but for STANDING (hip=0), + knee produces foot FORWARD (opposite of convention intent). Need hip extension (leftHip negative, leg swings back) combined with knee flexion to bring foot behind body.

RIG_LIMITATION_KNEE_SIGN_STANDING: Renderer knee sign convention assumes hip-flexed (seated) context. For STANDING (hip=0), positive knee produces foot forward (opposite of anatomical knee flexion which should produce foot backward toward butt). Cannot achieve knee bent + foot behind body in standing pose via positive knee alone. Workaround: combine hip extension (negative hip) + knee flexion. RECOMMEND renderer tier fix: knee sign convention should be context-aware OR add separate hip-extension-aware foot positioning joint.
